verdict.rationale: Gitea's own materials say it tracks requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues, and manages work through kanban boards. That covers both the board and the column parts of the story. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of board behavior (column customization, moving cards, board scopes) and independent or hands-on corroboration of kanban use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns

citations.quote: Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues.
Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
